Why do we want term limits? It's not hard to understand. Congressional approval is currently sitting in the low teens. It fell to 11% not long ago. Our congress is doing an awful job so get some fresh blood in there. But I think looking at the source of the problem you'd realize pretty quickly it's that somehow we keep voting in representatives that don't actually represent the people. In fact it's incredibly bizarre that even though there's fewer people than ever that identify as a republican or a democrat that nearly every single seat at most all branches of government, state and federal, is taken up by people holding affiliation to these two parties.

This is not a coincidence and is a consequence of our voting system, which is completely archaic. Imagine a state is broken up evenly with 20% libertarian, 20% green, 25% republican, 30% democrat, 5% other. This state gets to send 10 representatives to congress. What is going to be the party makeup of those 10 representatives? The answer, stupefyingly, is 100% democrat. How? We split that state up into districts (which is subject to political corruption in the form of gerrymandering) and hold a single first-past-the-post election in every single district. District 1. How do they vote? We said the state was evenly split up so that's 30% democrat, 25% republican, ... District 2? Exactly the same. And you end up with democrats, even with only 30% of the actual support, getting 100% of the seats.

Imagine instead you had a state wide election for those 10 seats. Any party that gained at least 10% of the vote would be guaranteed at least one seat. Suddenly now you end up with 3 democratic representatives, 3 republican, 2 green, and 2 libertarian. Your representatives actually become representative of the population. Simple!

And as an aside the vast majority of developed nations now use these sort of proportional systems to determine their representatives and consequently why there is far more diversity in representation. Even the "Pirate Party" has managed to get representatives into several different European countries for instance. I'll just sum up with a list.
